Gambit Esports (formerly known as Gambit Gaming) is a Russian professional esports organization owned by MTS, a Moscow-based telecommunications company. It was the first CIS team to win a CS:GO Major Championship, having done so at PGL Major Kraków 2017.

  • January 8th - Gambit Gaming sign HS.GG. [1]
  • January 19th - beAst joins as coach. [2]
  • April 18th - wayLander steps down from the Gambit roster. [3]
  • April 19th - spaze joins Gambit Gaming. [4]
  • June 20th - wayLander is acquired by FlipSid3 Tactics. [5]
  • September 9th - Gambit Gaming replace beAst with TsaGa as the coach of the team. [6]
  • September 24th - Gambit Gaming announce that spaze has been demoted to a substitute position, while kUcheR joins as a stand-in. [7]
  • October 2nd - hooch announces that he has been removed from the team. [8]
  • October 12th - Gambit Gaming sign Zeus and acquire HObbit on a six month-long loan from Tengri. [9][10].
  • July 23rd - Gambit Esports win PGL Major Kraków 2017, defeating Immortals 2-1 in the grand final.
  • August 2nd - Gambit Esports acquire HObbit from Tengri. [11]
  • August 9th - Zeus and kane are acquired by Natus Vincere following internal disagreements. [12]
  • August 15th - Gambit Gaming add fitch on trial. [13]
  • October 4th - Gambit Gaming sign Andi as coach. [14]
  • November 15th - fitch is added on a permanent basis.
  • February 6th - seized joins the team on trial and fitch is benched. [15]
  • May 27th - seized is benched, mir is leased from Vega Squadron for a month. [16]
  • June 10th - Andi resigns from his coaching position. [17]
  • June 29th - Gambit Esports announce that they have purchased mir's contract from Vega Squadron. [18]
  • July 3rd - fitch's contract expires and he becomes a free agent. [19]
  • July 24th - B1ad3 is loaned to the team as a coach from FlipSid3 Tactics till September 30th. [20]
  • September 30th - Gambit Esports bench Hobbit. [21]
  • October 7th - FlipSid3 Tactics and Gambit Esports agree to extend B1ad3's loan until the end of October. [22]
  • October 16th - Gambit Esports bench AdreN and put him on the transfer list. [23]
  • November 1st - Gambit Esports and seized part ways. [24]
  • November 6th - Gambit Esports sign dimasick from AVANGAR. [25]
  • November 8th - Hobbit signs for HellRaisers. [26]
  • November 13th - Gambit Esports sign Ax1Le to complete roster. [27]
  • December 1st - Gambit Esports release AdreN. [28]
  • December 31st - Gambit Esports sign bondik on a 2 month trial, dimasick is moved to a substitute position. [29]
  • March 17th - Gambit Esports release bondik and B1ad3. [30]
  • May 21st - Gambit Esports announce that they are putting their main lineup on hold until Fall 2019. As a result, the remainder of their lineup is benched and transfer listed. [31]
  • June 6th - Ax1Le is transferred onto Gambit Youngsters. [32]
  • September 26th - Team Spirit acquire mir from Gambit Esports. [33]
  • September 1st - dimasick's contract expires and he leaves Gambit Esports. [34]
  • December 2nd - Gambit Esports release mou and Dosia. [35]
  • October 5th - Gambit Youngsters are promoted to the main team. [36]
  • October 10th - F_1N is moved to an analyst position as a result of his ESIC ban. [37]
  • February 2nd - supra is acquired by Nordavind. [38]
  • August 13th - F_1N resumes coaching Gambit Esports following the expiration of his ESIC ban. [39]
  • March 16th - groove leaves his organizational position to focus on coaching. [40]
  • April 24th - Gambit Esports' roster is acquired by Cloud9. [41]
